main.description: Writes a release record to a package, at the record key equal to its version. The caller must be a maintainer of the package, and every blob the release references must have been uploaded with 'dev.zena-lang.host.uploadArtifact'. The release counts once the maintainers' threshold attests it.

errors.name: VersionExists
errors.description: The package has a release of that version. Releases are never replaced.

errors.name: BlobNotFound
errors.description: The release references a blob that was not uploaded to the package.

errors.name: InvalidRelease
errors.description: The release does not follow 'dev.zena-lang.package.release', an artifact kind is one the host does not store, or the release fails the checks of 'Validating releases': its source archive is not the artifact it names or disagrees with it, its manifest names another package than the profile, or a dependency is not published or is retracted.
